The '''Lowlands''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. It consisted of many peaks that overlooked arable land. The [[Lowland Clans]] of the [[S'kytri]] ruled over the Lowlands from mountaintop citadels that overlooked mountainside farms where their [[Outland Clan]] serfs toiled.
